title: Henry Park - People Ops Manager Prep Q2 2026
content:
Notes to self for manager prep meeting (Q2 planning) - informal scratchpad.

Context:
- Role: Senior People Ops Manager (onboarding, L&D, comp planning support).
- Last quarter highlights: rolled out updated onboarding checklist, ran two cohort L&D workshops, supported Dedicated hiring plan + compensation modeling.
- Current focus: Q2 headcount and learning programs, manager training launch, streamline new-hire kit.

Talking points / wins to surface:
- Onboarding: reduced time-to-first-PR metrics from 18 -> 12 days for eng interns (pilot cohort). Anecdote: Sam K. said smoother access flow helped ramp.
- L&D workshops: 2 cohorts (manager communication + interview training). Survey NPS ~72 (n=45). Feedback: more role-specific breakouts needed.
- Hiring ops: tightened offer-to-accept timeline by 20% by templating negotiation playbook.
- Cost-efficiency: consolidated vendor subscriptions (training platform) saved ~$6k/yr.

Areas to raise / ask for support:
- Headcount ask: need +1 full-time People Ops generalist to handle onboarding scale for Dedicated/private customers (projected hires +20% next 6 months). Rationale: current team overloaded, risk to SLA on new-hire provisioning.
- Budget: request approval to extend L&D trainer contract for 6 months (~$18k) to build role-specific tracks (eng, product, customer-success). ROI: faster ramp, fewer support tickets for access.
- Cross-functional: ask Eng infra for help automating IAM provisioning (ticket: JIRA-ENG-5582). Time estimate: 2 sprints.

Performance self-notes (for calibration):
- Strengths: project ownership (onboarding overhaul), stakeholder management (recruiting + hiring managers), measurable impact on ramp metrics.
- Development areas: strategic influence at exec level (need to be more concise in exec updates), data analysis skill for forecasting (want more comfort with SQL / Looker).
- Example where I struggled: negotiation escalation with two mid-Sr offers, delayed decision due to compensation band ambiguity. Action: propose clear compensation bands & decision matrix.

Career / growth ask (what I want from manager):
- Guidance on promotion timeline to Director People Ops in next 12-18 months: what milestones to hit, visibility projects to sponsor.
- Recommend 1x mentoring session monthly with a People leader (ops lead or head of talent).
- Support for 3-month shadow on product strategy to learn cross-functional levers.

OKRs / Goals for Q2 (draft):
- Reduce new-hire provisioning time to <48 hours for hosted API hires (current 72h) - owner: me + infra.
- Launch role-specific manager training pilot for eng + CS (complete 2 cohorts, NPS >=70).
- Hire +1 People Ops generalist and reduce onboarding backlog by 40%.
- Build baseline ramp metrics dashboard (Looker) for org-wide visibility.

Risks / blockers:
- Hiring freeze possibility if quota misses in sales (impact on HC ask). Contingency: prioritize automation and temporary contractors.
- Infra bandwidth for IAM automation (need manager to escalate).

Agenda for 1:1 with manager (30 min):
1) Quick wins + metrics (5m)
2) Headcount + budget ask (10m) - discuss hiring case and timing
3) Career progression / promotion rubric (8m) - clarify expectations
4) Blockers & escalations (5m) - infra help, comp bands

Action items to bring to the meeting:
- One-pager headcount & budget case (I'll attach confluence link)
- Walkthrough of onboarding dashboard (screenshots + key metrics)
- Draft comp-band proposals for mid-Sr roles

To-dos after 1:1 (notes placeholder):
- Update hiring request based on feedback
- Kick off SOW amendment for L&D trainer if approved
- Open escalation ticket with Eng infra (cc: product ops)

Loose thoughts / brainstorms:
- Idea: "redwood new-hire playbook" microsite with automated checklists and Slack bot reminders (low-effort, high-value).
- Consider pilot pairing managers with onboarding buddies for first 30 days.

Quick reference links (notes):
- Onboarding dashboard: Looker/dashboards/onboarding-ramp (request access if needed)
- Training survey results: https://forms.redwood.com/reports/lnd-q1-2026
- Offer templates: google-drive/people-ops/templates/offer-templates-v3.docx

Notes to self: stay concise in exec summary, bring concrete numbers, have fallback plans if HC denied.

----
End of scratchpad. Will tidy into a one-pager after manager Q/A and finalize for exec readout.
